# .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/AGENTS.md

The GitHub issue forms; the parent [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) lists the rest of the GitHub settings.

## What lives here

- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml`: a bug report.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml`: a feature request.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/accuracy-regression.yml`: a benchmark task that scores worse, named by its task id from [bench/tasks](../../bench/tasks/AGENTS.md).
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/source-request.yml`: a request to add a keyless source or site.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`: turns off blank issues and links the security advisory form and the docs.

## Rules

- Forms use only the GitHub default labels `bug` and `enhancement`. This repo has no labels file ([issue form syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/using-templates-to-encourage-useful-issues-and-pull-requests/syntax-for-issue-forms)).
- Security reports go to the advisory form, never to an issue.
